title: Hecla Mining Company Completes Redemption of Senior Notes
summary: Achieves unencumbered balance sheet, unlocking full capital flexibility Hecla Mining Company (NYSE:HL) ("Hecla", or the "Company") is pleased to announce today that it has completed the full redemption of its remaining $263 million 7.25% Senior Notes (“Notes”) due 2028, completing a significant milestone in the Company’s balance sheet transformation. Full redemption of senior notes enhances Hecla’s financial flexibility and capacity to invest in strategic growth investments, positioning Hecla to maximize value from its world-class silver portfolio. The Company utilized the cash proceeds from the recently completed Casa Berardi sale along with cash on hand to fund the redemption of the Notes and the payment of accrued and unpaid interest.
